extension.description: Original skin: Andy Morton[CR]Original design: Simon Brunton[CR]Skinner: Julian Michel
extension.news: [B]New[/B][CR]- add support for Kodi v22 (Piers)[CR]- add the Dolby Vision profile to the HDR media flag[CR]- add extra title info, parental rating and backend name to PVR items[CR]- add live bitrates, queue levels and the subtitle decoder to the process info dialog[CR]- add the ungroup button to the video versions manager[CR]- add the controller image to the peripheral settings dialog[CR]- add support for Skin Shortcuts v3[CR]- add a list dialog for the skin settings whose answer is not a switch[CR]- add an option to show titles on the artwork, in the wall views and on the widgets[CR]- add an option to show two widgets on screen at once[CR]- add the PVR providers window, which lists the broadcasters behind the channels[CR]- give the audio and the subtitle stream a row each in the fullscreen info[CR]- add a spinner to the weather widget while it updates[CR]- add the last update time to the weather window[CR][CR][B]Improved[/B][CR]- step through subtitles in both directions in the video OSD[CR]- open the subtitle settings from the subtitle name in the video OSD[CR]- name audio and subtitle streams by their stream name[CR]- detect Dolby Atmos and DTS:X from the stream instead of the file name[CR]- separate genres, directors and writers with commas[CR]- hide duration based information during live playback[CR]- read codec and channel labels from shared lookup maps[CR]- size the process info dialog to the rows it has to show[CR]- pre-configure the layout, artwork and sort of every widget the skin offers[CR]- allow any item limit to be set for main menu widgets[CR]- localise the artwork type names in the widget artwork pickers[CR]- stop the widget artwork picker hiding the types the preview items lack[CR]- remove the clear logo and fake landscape widget artwork types[CR]- offer date sorting on live TV and radio widgets[CR]- carry the sort of every pre-configured widget into the management dialog[CR]- remove the always show settings link setting, as that item is now fixed[CR]- sort the unwatched music videos widget by title rather than at random[CR]- drop the fifty item cap on the most played album and song playlists[CR]- disable the delete and hide buttons on menu items that cannot be removed[CR]- disable the restore button while nothing has been deleted[CR]- give every group in the shortcut and widget pickers its own icon[CR]- name the reset button in the skin settings for everything it clears[CR]- offer the artwork titles and watched indicator settings from a view's sub menu[CR]- return to the sub menu when the view picker is left with back[CR]- stop windows and dialogs drawing a full screen fanart layer with no fanart[CR]- clear the screen on the windows that fill it[CR]- place the line under a focused row with the control rather than in its texture[CR]- reduce the textures to the channels they use, cutting texture memory by three fifths[CR]- put a scrolled text box back to the start when a dialog or menu closes over it[CR]- drive every scroll reset from one token instead of twenty six properties[CR]- scroll every label at a speed set by its own font size[CR][CR][B]Fixed[/B][CR]- fix audio channel labels naming layouts a channel count cannot identify[CR]- fix the Dolby Vision profile 7 flag reading as one word[CR]- fix the audio flag describing more than one track at a time[CR]- fix the twelfth line of system information not being shown[CR]- fix the last row of the game controller lists being cut through[CR]- fix the recently added artists widget pointing at a playlist that does not exist[CR]- fix the music add-on widget resolving to nothing[CR]- fix the live TV and radio widgets opening the videos window[CR]- fix the rip disc row and the artist widgets pointing at missing artwork[CR]- fix video widgets falling back to music artwork[CR]- fix the movie sets, music nodes and custom widgets carrying the wrong type[CR]- fix the weather widget being recognised by a property v3 never sets[CR]- fix the seeded live TV and radio widgets differing from the picker's[CR]- fix the three widget artwork slots drawing over one another[CR]- fix widgets picked from the picker drawing icons whatever their content[CR]- fix the games widget not offering the sort orders it lists add-ons for[CR]- fix the random movie, TV show and album widgets being named two things[CR]- fix the management dialog offering no sort for the pre-configured widgets[CR]- fix the random movie and music video widgets sorting the wrong way round[CR]- fix the widget property pickers showing a crossed circle beside every option[CR]- fix the Skin Shortcuts entry points showing while the add-on is disabled[CR]- fix the login screen scrollbar covering the profile list[CR]- fix the profile settings scrollbar rendering without a track or a bar[CR]- fix the debug grid ignoring its offset on the masked aspect ratios[CR]- fix the channel label in the fullscreen OSD and the guide dialog being blank[CR]- fix the watched status bar and its overlay swapping size in the video wall[CR]- fix the focused status badge in the music wall low view being mis-sized at 16:9[CR]- fix the music window fading twice on open[CR]- fix episodes losing the skin's numbering in the list view and on the widgets[CR]- fix the channel lists showing the programme thumbnail where the channel logo belongs[CR]- fix rows in the video and music OSD moving nowhere when their button is hidden[CR]- fix left and right leaving the subtitle stream row in the video OSD[CR]- fix there being no way out of the TV guide when the scrollbar is hidden[CR]- draw every icon at the size the largest control on screen draws it[CR]- fix the movie artwork placeholder never being drawn, the file sitting apart[CR]- fix the OSMC logo on the home and login screens being resampled every frame[CR]- fix the sub menu arrows being a 32 pixel image in a 30 pixel box[CR]- fix the shortcut management dialog arrows rendering at a ninth of full strength[CR]- render the video, duration, timer and reminder flags at the size they are drawn[CR]- redraw the padlock an encrypted channel falls back to at the size it is drawn[CR]- fix the watched flag in the PVR recordings list being drawn half again its size[CR]- fix the subtitle position marker in the calibration screen being stretched[CR]- redraw the busy spinner with antialiased edges[CR]- add a spinner sized for the places that draw one small[CR]- fix the busy spinner sitting below and right of the middle of the screen[CR]- make the error icon monochrome, the one icon carrying a colour of its own[CR]- fix drop shadows on the home menu icons and the PVR timer icon[CR]- fix the video watched status setting leaving movie sets untouched
